description: Quote the exact Gold price to make animated pixel sprites of a character from one of the user's own still pictures: 10 Gold for each portrait or typed move, 80 Gold for the walk in 8 directions (10 for each facing), and 25 Gold for each facing of a game move. Returns gold_cost and quote_token. It does not place an order or charge Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_generate_character_sprites with the same inputs and the quote_token.

actions.description: Preset portrait moves, each one at most once, 10 Gold each. actions and custom_actions together hold at most 10 moves. An order needs at least one move from actions, custom_actions, walk_8_directions or game_moves.

custom_actions.description: Moves in the user's own words, for example "raises a glass in a toast".

details.description: Optional details the picture does not show, for example "a captain's rapier".

game_moves.description: Game moves, each move at most once, 25 Gold for each facing. At most 24 facings in all. A facing that fails is refunded 25.

facings.description: The facings to make this move in, each one at most once. S faces the viewer (down the screen), N faces away (up the screen), E faces right and W faces left; SE, NE, NW and SW are between them.

move.description: The game move. idle, walk, run and sprint loop; the others play one time, and death stops on its last frame.

source_image_id.description: UUID of one of the user's own still pictures, from chargen_search_gallery. The character is drawn from it.

style.description: FINE (the default) draws more detail and adds HD files. CHUNKY draws bigger, simpler pixels. Each style of a picture has its own base sprite.

title.description: Optional name for these sprites in the user's library.

walk_8_directions.description: true adds a looping walk in all 8 facings, 80 Gold (10 for each facing). A facing that fails is refunded 10.

name: chargen_quote_character_sprites
title: Quote character sprites
